{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by keeping the highest sample_seq per patient_id
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
deduplicated_df = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Calculate the mean biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = deduplicated_df['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_final"}
